**The project is now `rota-order` everywhere, and so is the import name.** This is a breaking change:

```python
# up to 0.7                      # from 0.8
import rota                      import rota_order as ro
import rota.plot as rp           import rota_order.plot as rp
rota.maps.rpm_order_map(...)     ro.maps.rpm_order_map(...)
```

Functions, arguments and results are unchanged. Environment variables `ROTA_*` are now `ROTA_ORDER_*`, and sidecar files record `"rota_order_version"`.

**The plotting gallery now uses realistic synthetic recordings**: a four-cylinder engine run-up with upshifts, combustion bursts, a cabin and road noise (`synth_scenario("ice_runup")`), and an electric drive whose gear whine passes a structural resonance (`synth_scenario("ev_runup")`). All figures: [docs/plotting.md](https://github.com/ZhenxianLi/rota-order/blob/v0.8.0/docs/plotting.md).

**Engine run-up, Campbell diagram with the firing orders 2, 4 and 6** — `rp.rpm_frequency_map(fmap, **rp.SOUND_PRESSURE, mark_orders=(2, 4, 6))`

![Campbell diagram](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ZhenxianLi/rota-order/v0.8.0/docs/images/plot_rpm_frequency_map.png)

**Tacholess speed through the upshifts** — `rp.rpm_from_ridge(ridge, reference=(t, ice.rpm_mean))`

![rpm_from_ridge](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ZhenxianLi/rota-order/v0.8.0/docs/images/plot_rpm_from_ridge.png)

**Electric drive, the whine lowered by 10 dB: before, after and the difference** — `rp.compare_maps({"original": ev_omap, "order 40 -10 dB": ev_omap_y}, **rp.SOUND_PRESSURE, difference=True, dynamic_range=70)`

![compare_maps](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ZhenxianLi/rota-order/v0.8.0/docs/images/plot_compare_maps.png)

**The whine against the ECMA-418-1 criterion** — `rp.order_prominence(prom)`

![order_prominence](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ZhenxianLi/rota-order/v0.8.0/docs/images/plot_order_prominence.png)

**Fixed:** order maps with `min_rpm` placed frames below the floor at the floor speed with a wrong shaft angle; they are now left out.
